NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE 1 ZONING MAP AMENDMENT APPLICATION

Applicant: The Michaels Development Company I, L.P.
Property Location: 136 North Kedzie Avenue, Chicago, IL 60612
Proposed Zoning: B3-3 Community Shopping District

Lot Area: 19,525 square feet (recorded) / 18,914 sf (measured)

The Michaels Development Company I, L.P. is the “Applicant” for a Type 1 Zoning Map Amendment for
the subject property located at 136 North Kedzie Avenue, Chicago, IL 60612. The Applicant requests a re-
zoning from the C1-5 Neighborhood Commercial District and B3-3 Community Shopping District to a
unified B3-3 Community Shopping District to develop a 5-story building containing 51 affordable dwelling
units, approximately 3,800 square feet of ground floor commercial space, and approximately 12 on-site
accessory parking spaces (including 1 accessible space). The building will include approximately 26 bicycle
spaces. The floor area will be approximately 65,606 square feet. The overall building height will be 80 feet,
due to the presence of @ rooftop screening element. The predominance of the building will be 60 feet in

height.

The site is located on the west side of North Kedzie Avenue, bounded by West Lake Street on the north and
West Maypole Avenue on the south. The surrounding property to the north and east is zoned C1-3
Neighborhood Commercial District and C3-1 Commercial, Manufacturing, and Employment District. The

property located south and west of the site is zoned B3-3 Community Shopping District and RM-5
Residential Multi-Unit District.

The site is a transit-served location due to its proximity to the Kedzie and Lake Green Line CTA Station.
NARRATIVE ZONING ANALYSIS

(a) Floor Area and Floor Area Ratio:

i, Lot area: 19,525 sf (recorded) / 18,632 sf (measured)
ii, Total proposed building area: 65,606 sf
iii. Proposed FAR: 3.36 (based on recorded lot area) / 3.52 (as measured)*

(b) Density (Lot Area Per Dwelling Unit): 382 sf/unit (based on recorded lot area)*
(c) Amount of off-street parking: 12**

(d) Setbacks: 0” (Front, Sides, and Rear at-grade) and
5° (Rear at floors containing dwelling units)

(e) Building height: 57°-8” (underside of 5" floor ceiling)
80” (top of rooftop structure)

(i Off-street Loading: 1 (10°x25’)

*The surveyor has identified a discrepancy between location of the west line of Kedzie Avenue as platted in
the subdivisions from 1875 and 1878 and its actual location based on physical conditions.

**Pyuysuant to Section 17-10-0102-B(1)(a), the project is providing reduced minimum off-street parking due
to its proximity to the Kedzie and Lake Green Line CTA Station, which is located adjacent to the site.
